cycle_report.summary: Cycle 1 fully hardened the StoryForge startup and runtime security surfaces. All four mission criteria were met and verified against a live server running on port 5100. The following was accomplished: (1) Removed import-path hijack surface by eliminating sys.path.insert(0, ...) from both run.py and web/app.py, replacing it with a runtime _validate_sys_path_security() audit function. (2) Eliminated the TOCTOU race in port checks via _preflight_port_bind() which uses bind-first semantics. (3) Enforced a single source of truth for port: STORYFORGE_PORT env var -> Config.PORT -> uvicorn. (4) Added _parse_port() to config.py for actionable error messages on bad port values. (5) Delivered a comprehensive security regression test suite (test_security_regression.py) covering all four attack surfaces. 24 tests passed, 0 failed, 1 skipped (by design). Adversarial testing found and fixed 2 real bugs: non-integer STORYFORGE_PORT and out-of-range port handling.
achievements: TOCTOU vulnerability eliminated: bind-first _preflight_port_bind() replaces check-then-use pattern
Import-path hijack surface removed: sys.path.insert(0,...) eliminated from run.py and web/app.py
Single source of truth enforced: STORYFORGE_PORT -> Config.PORT -> uvicorn.run(port=Config.PORT)
_validate_sys_path_security() added: runtime audit warns on world/group-writable sys.path entries
_parse_port() helper added to config.py: actionable error messages for non-integer or missing port env vars
OverflowError handling added for out-of-range port values (0-65535 validation)
Security regression test suite: 24 tests across 4 categories (A=PATH, B=Port race, C=Config drift, D=Writable-path)
Live runtime verified: server confirmed on port 5100 with /health -> ok
Adversarial testing found and fixed 2 real bugs before sign-off
issues: LIVE3 test (occupied-port clean exit) skipped by design — cannot test while server is live on the same port; verified in isolation
Project root directory has mode 0o40775 (group-writable) — flagged with security warning, not a mission blocker since group-writable is different from world-writable
